data.exact_reserve_text: Nevertheless, net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit (Prior: n/a) for the year. Movements in claims incurred relate to prior underwriting years and are not directly related to, or comparable to, premium movements in the period.
data.standardized_narrative: For 2022, Syndicate 1254 reported net reserve releases of GBP 4.7 million, contributing to a profit for the year. This movement relates to prior underwriting years, consistent with the syndicate's focus on legacy reinsurance. Despite an explicit uplift to reserves for anticipated economic and social inflation, the overall development was favourable.
raw_causal_phrases: net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit
Movements in claims incurred relate to prior underwriting years
global economy saw a considerable increase in the rate of inflation
explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation
claim estimates include an explicit uplift for inflation based on expectations of both economic and social inflation
Current economic inflation is high by recent standards, so it is likely that claim inflation will be higher than the rate implicit captured by claim development patterns.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported net of reinsurance as no gross figure was available. The syndicate's first year of operation, 2022, means no prior year comparative data is available for some financial statements.
